description: This Python script is designed to merge multiple runtime manifests (specifically Django and Flasky) into a single combined manifest. It provides functions to read, merge, and write JSON manifests, with rules for merging dicts, lists, and scalar conflicts. It includes a CLI interface for specifying the manifest files and output path.

methods.name: bool _is_namespaced_key(key: str)
methods.description: Checks if a given key contains '__', indicating it's explicitly namespaced.

methods.name: List[Any] _dedupe_scalars(items: List[Any])
methods.description: Removes duplicates from a list of scalar values while preserving order.

methods.name: Any _merge(a: Any, b: Any)
methods.description: Recursively merges two data structures (dicts, lists, scalars) with Django being the primary source.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _read_json(path: Path)
methods.description: Reads a JSON file and returns the data as a dictionary.

methods.name: None _write_json(path: Path, data: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Writes a dictionary to a JSON file with indentation.

methods.name: str combine_manifests( django_manifest_path: str, flasky_manifest_path: str, out_path: str, )
methods.description: Main function that reads two manifest JSON files, merges them into one, and writes the result to a specified output file.

methods.name: int main()
methods.description: CLI entry point that parses arguments and invokes the combine_manifests function.

ctags.signature: ( django_manifest_path: str, flasky_manifest_path: str, out_path: str, )
